verdict.rationale: QuickBooks ships both a first-party conversational AI (Intuit Intelligence) that answers financial questions like 'What's driving my profit?' or 'How are my invoices doing this month?' using live data, and an official MCP server exposing 145 tools with full CRUD plus 11 financial reports for programmatic, API-grounded querying by agents like Claude Code. Together these directly support an AI agent answering affordability-style questions grounded in live ledger data pulled via API. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that answers are accurate for complex affordability queries, and no example transcript showing a direct 'can we afford X' style response.
